notes: Part 1 of 7 in the Collaboration Restructure program (Docs/COLLAB_RESTRUCTURE_PLAN.md). Five behaviour corrections: (1) offers refused over unpublished products at BOTH creation levels, which required wiring the offer-config validator into the previously-unvalidated in-campaign inline path; (2) commission no longer displayed to customers as a discount; (3) campaign-basics money card shows real balance and hides when no set needs funding; (4) one canonical offer vocabulary (discount|volume|bogo|bundle|free_gift) across web + mobile with a migration for existing rows — coupled to (1) because the validator enforces the vocabulary; (5) the frontend-only 7-day start-date rule removed. Founder decided unpublish-inside-live-offer WARNS and proceeds. No model, layout, step-order or flow change. Parts 2-7 explicitly out of scope.

release.ota_gap_safe: Backend may deploy AHEAD of the mobile OTA. Wiring validation into the campaign path (§1.1) made pre-canonical mobile payloads reachable — offer_type 'flat'/'percentage' with a config of just {value} would have 422'd every conversion/hybrid invite from an un-updated phone. backfillDiscountSubType infers sub_type from the legacy type using the same rule as migration 147, so old and new builds both work and deploy order does not matter. Covered by unit tests O1-O6.
